metadata.description: Strix Open — the SGRF v1 governance-review skills. Review how any system governs execution, score it on four orthogonal axes, and wire a first governed action. Advisory; no Strix account required.

plugins.name: strix-governance
plugins.description: Run a Strix Governance Review (SGRF v1) on a system (/strix-governance:runtime-governance-review), a PR (/strix-governance:govern-pr), or a release (/strix-governance:release-readiness) — and wire a first governed, recorded action (/strix-governance:strix-wire). Self-host governed AI egress — a de-identifying proxy for OpenAI/Anthropic calls plus a local Claude Code prompt hook (/strix-governance:govern-ai-egress). Plugin skills are namespaced /strix-governance:<skill>. The three review lenses are advisory and run anywhere; strix-wire needs no account — Sandbox Mode auto-provisions a short-lived credential and Offline Mode makes no network calls.

plugins.name: strix-verifier
plugins.description: Independently verify Strix governance artifacts — signed evidence, approvals, quorums, agent-swarm runs, tool-gateway receipts, and CT proofs. Run the namespaced skill /strix-verifier:strix-verify or the strix_verify MCP tool; Ed25519 + JWKS, offline-capable, no Strix account. The verdict is reproducible locally or fully offline.
